# ShinySpaces

> Professional residential, commercial, and Airbnb/vacation-rental cleaning company serving Heber City, Utah and the surrounding Heber Valley.

ShinySpaces provides free, no-obligation estimates. Nothing is scheduled until the customer confirms scope and price. Contact by phone, text, or email — no online booking form exists yet.

## Contact

- Phone / text: (626) 549-9782
- Email: hello@shinyspaces.info
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 7:00 AM–7:00 PM, Sunday closed
- Service area: Heber City, Midway, Park City, Kamas, Hideout, Daniel, Charleston, and Wallsburg, Utah
